messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: [stan] stan output csv column-major (#109)
parts:
On 6/7/13 5:09 PM, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
> I do not understand 'agnostic' in this context :)

I meant does your code not care if the output order is row major
or column major?

It's easier to write everything row major because that's the
natural structure of arrays, so I can do it recursively.

If I have to, I'll dump it out column major. It's not that
hard. Just more complex code. And less efficient (though time
is probably dominated by the file ops).

> RStan have not implemented the stuff about diagnostics yet. Currently, I am transforming that samples obtained from
> 'write_array' that is column-majored to row-majored before writing to CSV.

> I am working on adding the diagnostics stuff to rstan. Could someone add the doc about the diagnostics? What is really
> written into the csv files?

I second that request.

- Bob

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: [stan] stan output csv column-major (#109)
parts:
The same as in Stan, the code in rstan needs to know the output 
from write_array is row major or column major.  Now the output 
to R in memory is column-major and the output to csv is row major. 
So either way, rstan can deal with it.  But rstan does not have code 
to detect whether it is row / column major order. 

--
Jiqiang
